nodes.label: data-path-smoke workflow
nodes.rationale: Executes notebook 03 against the hosted release weekly so the weeks-3+ data path cannot silently break; skips cleanly when HF_TOKEN is absent (forks).

nodes.label: personalize workflow
nodes.rationale: Rewrites Colab badge URLs in template copies so notebooks open from and save back to the intern's own repo; excludes .github because the Actions token cannot push workflow changes; commit carries [skip ci].

nodes.label: smoke-test workflow
nodes.rationale: Proves the pipeline runs on the bundled sample and blocks commits that include real datasets.

nodes.label: data-leak-check job
nodes.rationale: Any committed parquet/zip/tar/feather fails; only the anonymized starter CSV and the queue sample CSV are allowed.

nodes.label: Deliverable notebooks must carry outputs check
nodes.norm_label: deliverable notebooks must carry outputs check
nodes.rationale: A filled work notebook with zero outputs usually means Colab saved an unrun copy; warns mid-track, hard error once paper_url.txt holds an https URL.

nodes.label: paper_url.txt format and data-credit check
nodes.rationale: Deployed paper must be reachable and carry the data-credit link; missing credit fails the build.

nodes.label: Anonymized starter dataset (30k pages x 44 cols)
nodes.norm_label: anonymized starter dataset (30k pages x 44 cols)

nodes.label: Prep-step engineered columns (log totals, has_clicks, measurable_opportunity)
nodes.norm_label: prep-step engineered columns (log totals, has_clicks, measurable_opportunity)

nodes.label: Setup Moment 2: Hugging Face gated access
nodes.norm_label: setup moment 2: hugging face gated access
nodes.rationale: Accept the gate before creating the token; a token created first gets 401 errors silently. Use a Read token.

nodes.label: Starter Dataset (30k rows x 44 cols, 32 clients)
nodes.norm_label: starter dataset (30k rows x 44 cols, 32 clients)

nodes.label: Skills Router (skills/README.md)
nodes.rationale: One skill per task keeps the assistant's small context window focused; more instructions make output worse.

nodes.label: Deployed Paper URL File (paper_url.txt)
nodes.rationale: Mandatory single line holding the deployed paper URL; currently a placeholder. CI notebook-output check becomes a hard error once it holds a real https:// URL.

nodes.label: scripts/ stays pristine; work goes in work/
nodes.norm_label: scripts/ stays pristine; work goes in work/
nodes.rationale: The reference pipeline is the baseline reviewers compare against.

nodes.label: Skill router (skills/README.md)
nodes.rationale: Load exactly one skill per task to keep assistant context small.

nodes.label: Do not paste data into third-party tools
nodes.norm_label: do not paste data into third-party tools

nodes.label: Observable signals only (no product decision flags)
nodes.norm_label: observable signals only (no product decision flags)
nodes.rationale: Product scores like health_score are excluded so models learn from evidence, not the product's own decision.

nodes.label: Systematic missingness by content_type
nodes.rationale: Blind fillna(0) silently encodes content type into features.

nodes.label: Tier metrics need a volume floor
nodes.norm_label: tier metrics need a volume floor
nodes.rationale: Low-volume tiers make CTR medians noisy; never read a tier median without stating its volume floor.

nodes.label: Treat every cloud AI tool as third-party processing
nodes.norm_label: treat every cloud ai tool as third-party processing

nodes.label: Circular result
nodes.rationale: Feeding the product's own decision to a model just teaches it to copy that decision.

nodes.label: Committed vs regenerated artifacts
nodes.rationale: Code and reports go in git; data and generated artifacts do not, so a quiet git status after a run is by design.

nodes.label: Never hardcode the Hugging Face token
nodes.norm_label: never hardcode the hugging face token
nodes.rationale: Repo is public; use getpass or Colab Secrets.

nodes.label: One-account rule
nodes.rationale: Mixing GitHub or Hugging Face accounts is the root of most access failures.

nodes.label: Pre-Publish Privacy Scan
nodes.rationale: Pages serves the public repo; scan served folder for private data, tokens, client names.

nodes.label: Relative Asset Paths
nodes.rationale: Absolute paths cause broken images on the served page.

nodes.label: Reusable General Skill Library
nodes.rationale: Every skill outside skills/flyrank/ is project-agnostic; delete the flyrank folder to reuse elsewhere.

nodes.label: Copy, Don't Edit the Reference Pipeline
nodes.norm_label: copy, don't edit the reference pipeline
nodes.rationale: scripts/ stays pristine as the baseline reviewers compare against.

nodes.label: Five-stage batch pipeline
nodes.rationale: Stages communicate only through files on disk so any stage can be re-run alone once its inputs exist.

nodes.label: is_declining_label target
nodes.rationale: Derived as trend_direction == 'down' (54.2% positive); a proxy, not an observed future outcome.

nodes.label: Cold start and bootstrapping from heuristics
nodes.norm_label: cold start and bootstrapping from heuristics

nodes.label: Cost / value spine
nodes.rationale: The best ML solution is the simplest system that creates reliable value under acceptable cost and risk.

nodes.label: Group / entity split
nodes.rationale: Random splits leak entity-specific patterns when many rows share a client or user.

nodes.label: ML as a system loop (data -> model -> decision -> changed world)
nodes.norm_label: ml as a system loop (data -> model -> decision -> changed world)

nodes.label: Decline vs consolidation, seasonality, SERP click loss, noise
nodes.norm_label: decline vs consolidation, seasonality, serp click loss, noise

nodes.label: Freestyle: AI Referral Opportunity
nodes.rationale: AI-session rows are sparse (~30k of 78.8M); treat as EDA/ranking, never a binary classifier.

nodes.label: Lane 3: Structured Content Archetype Clustering
nodes.rationale: No article text in release, so metric clustering must not be called semantic clustering.

nodes.label: Track workflow: question -> contract -> audit -> baseline -> lane -> validation -> ranked actions
nodes.norm_label: track workflow: question -> contract -> audit -> baseline -> lane -> validation -> ranked actions

nodes.label: Teaching workflow: framing -> cleaning -> baseline -> model -> evaluation -> recommendation
nodes.norm_label: teaching workflow: framing -> cleaning -> baseline -> model -> evaluation -> recommendation

nodes.label: Observed / measured / directional / decision-support language
nodes.rationale: No causal claims without a design, no claims of predicting the search engine's algorithm, no client-identifying details.

nodes.label: Leakage boundary (trend fields excluded from model features)
nodes.norm_label: leakage boundary (trend fields excluded from model features)
nodes.rationale: trend_pct and trend_direction are the label source, so they stay in the feature CSV but never in MODEL_*_FEATURES; anything derived from the 30d trend pair is the same family.

nodes.label: Query-table window overlap leakage
nodes.rationale: The fixed 90-day query window covers recent months; only *_prev30 columns are safe for a label on the final month.

nodes.label: Three-valued availability flags (use IS TRUE / IS NOT TRUE)
nodes.norm_label: three-valued availability flags (use is true / is not true)

nodes.label: Proxy label vs future-window label
nodes.rationale: The starter label is a bucket from the current window; a stronger capstone uses prior feature window -> future target window.

nodes.label: 'Right page to review first' decision-support framing
nodes.norm_label: 'right page to review first' decision-support framing
nodes.rationale: Ranks candidates for limited reviewer capacity; does not claim a refresh causes recovery.

nodes.label: Scored Population Summary
nodes.description: 30,000 rows scored post-filter; 16,262 declining-label rows; declining rate 0.542.

nodes.label: Trend Direction Definition
nodes.description: 30d vs previous 30d impression change: up >10%, down >10% decline, stable within +/-10%, flat insufficient data, new created within 30 days.

nodes.label: Finding 4: Freshness Multiplier
nodes.description: 31-90 day freshness window strongest stable growth ratio (7.88:1); refreshed 365+ pages show 3.2x health and 57x impressions; 361+ bucket unstable.

nodes.label: The State of AI-Driven SEO (March 2026)
nodes.description: 36-page public-safe portfolio study (341,701 content pieces, 57 brands) with direct aggregate comparisons as primary evidence and an exploratory ML appendix on 61,790 active records.

nodes.label: Refresh Model Results PDF
nodes.description: 6-page results PDF: headline KPIs, model quality, queue shape, feature importances, reason codes, top-queue preview, validation steps.
nodes.note: Untracked copy at repo root; numbers differ slightly from outputs/model_report.md (e.g. decision_tree precision@50 0.580 vs 0.540, high-confidence 3,602 vs 3,605), so it comes from a different run.

nodes.label: Finding 6: AI Referral Traffic Signal
nodes.description: AI referrals ~1.06% of sessions; high-AI pages have more impressions but weaker average position than no-AI pages.

nodes.label: Refresh Queue Confidence Chart
nodes.description: Bar chart of confidence tiers: low 15K (half the queue), medium 11.4K, high 3.6K - a small high-confidence first-review set.

nodes.description: Bar chart of random-forest importances: visibility/age features lead (days_with_impressions 0.158, log_impressions_90d 0.128, avg_position 0.109, content_age_days 0.0955); length, clicks, CTR, scroll, sessions, position_tier_top_3 trail.

nodes.label: Top Refresh Reason Codes Chart
nodes.description: Bar chart of reason-code frequency: declining_with_demand 13.2K, visible_model_opportunity 10.7K, low_ctr/ctr_review 9.76K, general_refresh_review 9.12K, model_decline_risk 8.42K, page_one_decay_risk 7.08K; thin_visible_page 82 and stale_visible_page 17 are rare.

nodes.label: Trend Direction Distribution Chart
nodes.description: Bar chart of trend_direction: down 16.3K (majority, equals the declining label), stable 5.96K, up 4.39K, new 2.24K, flat 1.15K.

nodes.label: Structural Portfolio Risks
nodes.description: Cannibalization of overlapping demand and incomplete indexing coverage.

nodes.label: Refresh Reason Codes
nodes.description: Explainability tags such as declining_with_demand, low_ctr_visible_page, model_decline_risk, visible_model_opportunity, ctr_review_candidate.

nodes.label: Refresh Opportunity Model Report
nodes.description: Generated markdown report: data summary, model comparison, queue shape, top features, top-10 queue preview, generated files list.

nodes.label: Finding 1: Anatomy of Growing Content
nodes.description: Growing pages are ~37.6% longer and ~20% younger than declining pages; observational.

nodes.label: Rule Baseline (No Model)
nodes.description: Hand-rule baseline: ROC AUC 0.627, precision@50 0.240; the comparison anchor.

nodes.label: Finding 2: Content Performance Curve
nodes.description: Health peaks at 61-90 days, decay cliff at 271-365 days, 365+ rebound concentrated in refreshed pages.

nodes.label: Finding 5: Engagement and Visibility Consistency
nodes.description: High scroll + high engagement +11.2 health; pages visible 80+ of 90 days score 46.8 vs 28.4 for sporadic.

nodes.label: Suggested Action Mix Chart
nodes.description: Horizontal bar chart of queue rows per suggested action: monitor ~13.1K dominates, refresh 8.18K, refresh_and_review_ctr 6.66K, refresh_and_review_engagement 1.99K, expand_and_refresh 82.

nodes.label: Content Refresh Playbook
nodes.description: Identify candidates, expand thin sections, update facts, improve engagement, resubmit and monitor at 30/60/90 days.

nodes.label: Health Score Composite (0-100)
nodes.description: Impressions 30 + position 30 + CTR 20 + scroll depth 20 points; internal summary metric, paired with raw search performance.

nodes.label: Recommended Next Validation Pass
nodes.description: Inspect top 25 high-confidence rows, check action vs editorial context, convert to capstone task, never auto-publish.

nodes.label: Plain-English Metric Guide
nodes.description: Interprets ROC AUC, average precision, precision@50 and recall at 0.5 threshold for mentors.

nodes.label: Active-Content Feature-Vector Subset
nodes.description: Local subset with impressions_90d > 0 and sessions_90d > 0 used for extended cuts and the ML appendix; introduces survivor bias in some cells.

nodes.label: Finding 8: Age-Freshness Matrix
nodes.description: Old-but-refreshed content (44.62) performs nearly as well as young-fresh content (44.12); mid-age stale is the main decay zone.

nodes.label: Exploratory ML Appendix
nodes.description: Pearson correlations, k-means (k=5) archetypes, PCA, random forest on health score, logistic regression on growth (71% holdout accuracy), shallow decision tree, percentile distributions.

nodes.label: Finding 10: Age-Controlled AI Model Cohorts
nodes.description: Provider families each lead in some age cohorts; no blanket winner and no blanket AI penalty.

nodes.label: Random Forest (Selected Model)
nodes.description: ROC AUC 0.750, avg precision 0.618, precision@50 0.740 vs baseline 0.240.

nodes.label: Final Ranked Refresh Queue
nodes.description: Ranked review queue exported to outputs/refresh_queue.csv with score, model probability, action, reasons.

nodes.label: Reversed and Nuanced SEO Myths
nodes.description: Search volume is a weak forecast; optimization flags mark leverage; word count is a threshold; AI content not penalized by default; freshness amplifies quality rather than replacing it.

nodes.label: Growth vs Decline Logistic Regression
nodes.description: Separates growing from declining pages; content age strongest negative signal, days visible and recent impressions positive.

nodes.label: Position Tiers
nodes.description: Top 3, Page 1 (4-10), Striking Distance (11-20), Page 3-5 (21-50), Deep (50+).

nodes.label: Finding 7: Intent x Competition x Depth
nodes.description: Transactional low-competition topics lead health and impressions; depth matters most where demand exists.
nodes.norm_label: finding 7: intent x competition x depth

nodes.label: Finding 3: Click Capture by Position Tier
nodes.description: Weighted CTR falls from 0.423% in top 3 to 0.050% deep (~88% drop).
nodes.norm_label: finding 3: click capture by position tier

nodes.label: Top Model Feature Importances
nodes.description: days_with_impressions 0.158, log_impressions_90d 0.128, avg_position 0.109, content_age_days 0.096, then length, clicks, ctr, scroll, sessions.

nodes.label: Model Comparison Table
nodes.description: decision_tree, logistic_regression, random_forest vs baseline_rules on ROC AUC, avg precision, precision@50, recall, F1.

nodes.label: Suggested Refresh Actions
nodes.description: monitor, refresh, refresh_and_review_ctr, refresh_and_review_engagement, expand_and_refresh.

nodes.label: Finding 9: Captured Click-Equivalent Value
nodes.rationale: Use clicks x CPC rather than impressions x CPC, since impressions are not billable clicks and inflate value.

nodes.label: Random Forest Health-Score Feature Importance
nodes.rationale: Average position and impressions dominate, but health score is constructed from those inputs, so importance is descriptive not causal.

nodes.label: is_declining_label Target
nodes.rationale: Supervised target derived from trend_direction == down; balance ~0.54.

nodes.label: Evidence Standard (Direct Comparisons Over ML)
nodes.rationale: Headline findings use direct aggregate comparisons; ML is exploratory appendix and never overrides portfolio evidence; external SEO beliefs are hypotheses.

nodes.label: Observational Limitations
nodes.rationale: Correlations do not prove causation; health score is internal; age confounds model comparisons; no p-values or CIs reported.

nodes.label: Refresh-Before-Decay Thesis
nodes.rationale: Most useful SEO decisions come from simple validated comparisons: refresh strong content before it decays, protect page-one assets, read composite scores through raw search performance.

nodes.label: Final Priority Score (Model + Rule Blend)
nodes.rationale: 0-100 score combining model decline probability with a non-leaky rule baseline so prioritisation is not driven by the model alone.

nodes.label: Client Holdout Validation Split
nodes.rationale: Split strategy actually used was client_holdout, so validation measures generalisation to unseen clients rather than rows from known clients.

nodes.label: Precision@50 Selection Metric
nodes.rationale: Winner chosen by top-of-queue precision because the deliverable is a ranked review queue, not a thresholded classifier.

nodes.label: Queue as Reviewer Aid, Not Auto-Publish
nodes.norm_label: queue as reviewer aid, not auto-publish
nodes.rationale: Safest first production use is to inspect high-confidence rows manually and check against editorial context; score is decision-support only.

nodes.label: Label Trap (is_declining_label <- trend_direction <- trend_pct)
nodes.rationale: trend_direction and trend_pct are the label's origin, so they are never features.

nodes.label: Heavy-Tail Handling (log1p / Spearman / tier medians)
nodes.rationale: Pearson on raw heavy-tailed traffic is dominated by giants and can flip sign after log transform.

nodes.label: Sample-Size Floor (~50 rows, ~30 cross-cuts)
nodes.rationale: A huge ratio from a tiny cell is noise; report insufficient data instead.

nodes.label: Verdict Mini-Test (CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE)
nodes.rationale: One claim, one test, one verdict; NO is an acceptable, publishable answer.

nodes.label: Print Base Rate Next to Metric
nodes.norm_label: print base rate next to metric
nodes.rationale: precision@50 of 0.60 means little until you know random picking's rate.

nodes.label: Frozen Baseline Once Modeling Starts
nodes.rationale: Moving goalposts mid-game convinces nobody.

nodes.label: precision@K Evaluation
nodes.rationale: For 'which ones first?' problems the honest metric is how many of the top K flags were right.

nodes.label: Reason Codes on Ranked Items
nodes.rationale: Reason codes make a ranked list trustworthy to a human reviewer.

nodes.label: Transparent Rule Score (no fitted weights)
nodes.rationale: A human-readable rule whose job is to be honestly beatable; a model without a baseline is a number without meaning.

nodes.label: Beat-the-Rule Framing
nodes.rationale: Production uses hand-written flags; rules run out when signals are many, tangled and shifting.

nodes.label: Content Decay Ranking Problem
nodes.rationale: The valuable decision is which of thousands of pages a human should fix first.

nodes.label: Data Provenance (Search Console + Analytics -> warehouse -> pseudonymized release)
nodes.norm_label: data provenance (search console + analytics -> warehouse -> pseudonymized release)

nodes.label: Four Framing Questions (decision, actor, cost, why ML)
nodes.norm_label: four framing questions (decision, actor, cost, why ml)
nodes.rationale: A model is never the goal; a better decision is.

nodes.label: Target Must Be Observed, Not Defined
nodes.norm_label: target must be observed, not defined
nodes.rationale: A label from someone's rule teaches the model the rule, not the world.

nodes.label: Banned Phrasings (proves, causes, predicted Google's algorithm)
nodes.norm_label: banned phrasings (proves, causes, predicted google's algorithm)

nodes.label: Claim Ladder (observed -> associated -> ranks -> causes)
nodes.rationale: Match words to evidence; cross-sectional data never supports 'doing X will produce Y'.

nodes.label: Repurposing (social post, employer summary, SEO title)
nodes.norm_label: repurposing (social post, employer summary, seo title)

nodes.label: Eight Pass/Needs-Work Rubric Axes
nodes.rationale: Sections 1-8 mirror the grading rubric so writing early keeps the work honest.

nodes.label: fact_content_daily_performance_sample table (final month)
nodes.rationale: Final month only; fine for query mechanics, never for label logic.

nodes.label: fact_content_query_90d table
nodes.rationale: Per-content context columns repeat on every row: ANY_VALUE, never SUM; 90d window overlaps final months.

nodes.label: Warehouse Release (~79M rows, gated Hugging Face)
nodes.norm_label: warehouse release (~79m rows, gated hugging face)

nodes.label: Missingness Follows Categories
nodes.rationale: Blind fillna(0) can inject a category signal into features.

nodes.label: Denominator-Weighted Rates
nodes.rationale: Average of per-row rates is not the true rate; weight by denominator and show n.

nodes.label: Product Flags Are Outputs, Never Inputs
nodes.norm_label: product flags are outputs, never inputs
nodes.rationale: health_score and similar flags encode a prior decision; using them as features is circular.

nodes.label: HF_TOKEN via Secrets, Never in Cells
nodes.norm_label: hf_token via secrets, never in cells

nodes.label: Missingness Follows content_type
nodes.rationale: Add has_-flags instead of blind fillna(0).

nodes.label: Panel Warnings (uneven history, GA4 zero-fill, sparse clients)
nodes.norm_label: panel warnings (uneven history, ga4 zero-fill, sparse clients)

nodes.label: Pseudonymous IDs (grouping/splitting only)
nodes.rationale: content_id and client_id are pseudonyms; use client_id for grouped splits, never as features.

nodes.label: Iterate Mid-Panel, Seal Final Month
nodes.rationale: The _sample is the panel's last month, the natural outcome window; developing there means developing inside the test window.

nodes.label: Grouped Split (GroupKFold by repeating entity)
nodes.rationale: Random splits let the model memorize a group; honest question is performance on unseen groups.

nodes.label: Label-Derived Features Leakage
nodes.rationale: Train with and without the suspect; a collapse from ~1.0 to ~0.7 is the confession.

nodes.label: Sealed Holdouts Leave Receipts
nodes.rationale: Commit the frame-builder and its metrics file; otherwise the sealed claim is merely trusted.

nodes.label: Send the Question to the Rows (aggregate-then-model)
nodes.norm_label: send the question to the rows (aggregate-then-model)
nodes.rationale: Aggregate in SQL and bring back only the small answer so 79M rows feel small.

nodes.label: Iterate on Sample, Finish on Full Table
nodes.norm_label: iterate on sample, finish on full table
nodes.rationale: Remote hosts rate-limit repeated heavy scans (HTTP 429); run the full scan once and cache.

nodes.label: Error Analysis Before Believing Scores
nodes.rationale: A metric without error analysis is decoration; suspiciously perfect top feature suggests leakage.

nodes.label: Data Contract Sections (unit, window, fields, missing, output)
nodes.norm_label: data contract sections (unit, window, fields, missing, output)

nodes.label: Field Classification (feature/label/context/excluded)
nodes.rationale: Every field in exactly one bucket; IDs are context, product flags and future info excluded.

nodes.label: Verify Every Contract Claim With a Query
nodes.norm_label: verify every contract claim with a query
nodes.rationale: A contract line without a query next to it is a guess.

nodes.label: Committed Metrics JSON Receipts
nodes.rationale: work/outputs/*.json are the receipts report numbers trace back to; datasets are never committed.

nodes.label: Client group holdout split
nodes.rationale: Hold out ~20% of clients so no client's pages appear in train and test; fall back to stratified row split only if <5 clients or a fold loses a class.

nodes.label: Starter model results (baseline P@50 0.240 vs RF 0.740)
nodes.norm_label: starter model results (baseline p@50 0.240 vs rf 0.740)

nodes.label: Model selection by precision@50
nodes.rationale: The deliverable is a ranked review queue, not a classifier, so the winner is chosen by a top-of-queue metric.

nodes.label: Hashed IDs for grouping/joining only
nodes.rationale: IDs are pseudonymous, not anonymous: never model features, never map back.

nodes.label: Library-version sensitivity of model metrics
nodes.rationale: Baseline P@50 0.240 reproduces exactly; random forest lands 0.68-0.74 depending on numpy/scikit-learn; the ~3x lift is the stable claim.

nodes.label: Baseline-vs-Model Comparison Table (same split, same metric)
nodes.norm_label: baseline-vs-model comparison table (same split, same metric)

nodes.label: Method Selection by Question Shape
nodes.rationale: Simplicity is a feature; add complexity only when the comparison earns it.

nodes.label: Human Validates Always (Run All)
nodes.rationale: An unverified answer is not an answer; automatic checks are the safety rail.

nodes.label: Interview Before Big Plans
nodes.rationale: Wrong assumptions caught in questions cost seconds; in finished code, hours.

nodes.label: One Task, One Fresh Conversation
nodes.rationale: Context window quality drops as it fills; old confusion bleeds into new work.

nodes.label: Search Before Assuming
nodes.rationale: Anchoring the assistant in real files prevents invented functions and columns.

nodes.label: Load One Skill Per Task
nodes.rationale: Assistant context window is small; filling it with everything degrades the one task at hand.
